acf.heading: Research information, documentation, and handling.
acf.intro: A central place for longer-form information that does not need to live on the storefront. This page is structured so Lion RUO can manage the final wording in WordPress.
acf.review_note: The current language is preview content. Testing, storage, shipping, and research-use statements should be replaced or approved by Lion RUO before production launch.

sections.title: About Lion RUO
sections.description: Lion RUO Peptides is presented as a research-supply catalog focused on clear product data, lot-level documentation, and a straightforward ordering experience.
items: Product information is organized around research catalog fields.
Longer descriptions and company information can be edited in WordPress.

sections.title: Quality & Testing
sections.description: This section is reserved for the client-approved explanation of testing standards, outside laboratory relationships, purity reporting, and release criteria.
items: Testing claims should match the actual process used by Lion RUO.
Purity and analytical claims should be supported by the applicable batch documentation.

sections.title: Certificates of Analysis
sections.description: Each product record can hold a lot number and a COA link so documentation can be surfaced directly from the catalog and individual product page.
items: COA links are managed per product.
Lot numbers can be displayed on catalog and product-detail views.

sections.title: Storage & Handling
sections.description: Product-specific storage fields already exist in the CMS model. The final handling language should reflect the actual product documentation supplied by Lion RUO.
items: Final handling instructions should come from approved product documentation.

sections.title: Shipping & Fulfillment
sections.description: This section can explain processing times, shipping methods, packaging, geographic restrictions, tracking, and other fulfillment details once the client confirms them.

sections.title: Research Use Only
sections.description: The storefront is designed around research-use-only positioning. The final legal and purchaser language will live on the Legal page and should be reviewed by the client before launch.
items: No dosing or administration guidance is included.
Product pages can link directly to the full research-use policy.
